task: T-120 — is a sheet held together by ONE crossover per interface still a plate?
leaf: A8.2 (structural rigidity), with A1.2 for the anchoring scheme
conditions: T = 300 K, k_BT = 4.141947 pN nm; aqueous 2 mM MgCl2; 40.0 x 40.35 nm tile, 15 duplexes at the SAXS-measured 2.69 nm; 8 symmetrically centred crossover columns, 56 crossovers; C-0022's SOLVED edge profile at 2 mM, 10 nm, 0.192 V; C-0017's 33.3333 pN/nm mandate
decision: The depleted lattice is parametrised by ONE number, the retained crossover count, through p_eff = p N/N_ret and D_perp = k_theta d/p_eff. Both reduce to C-0009's own constants at N_ret = N exactly, so every criterion below is that claim's published number times an exact power of the retained count — and each therefore INVERTS, which is what the task needs and what evaluating them at 14 would not have given.

bounds.name: crossovers in an anchor's influence patch, INTACT sheet
bounds.settles: C-0009's own 3.9 — 'four elements is not a continuum', and it is the baseline

bounds.name: crossovers in an anchor's influence patch, at the CONNECTIVITY CEILING
bounds.settles: UNDER ONE. The declared falsifier was that it stay at or above 1; it did not fire

bounds.name: the retained count at which the patch holds exactly one crossover
bounds.settles: the continuum reduction's own threshold, inverted rather than evaluated

bounds.name: the SPENT count at which the patch holds exactly one crossover
bounds.settles: 37 against C-0054's connectivity ceiling of 42: the sheet stops being a continuum FIVE crossovers before it stops being connected

bounds.name: ell_perp/d at the ceiling
bounds.settles: 1.06, still above 1 — the across-helix matched criterion does NOT see the failure

bounds.name: ell_par/p_eff at the ceiling
bounds.settles: 0.21 against C-0009's 0.83 intact: the criterion that already failed, failing 4x harder

bounds.name: the retained count ell_par/p_eff would need
bounds.settles: MORE than the sheet owns (56), which is C-0009's finding restated: this criterion fails on the intact sheet and no consumption level can rescue it

bounds.name: the foundation multiplier at which the two ceilings coincide
bounds.settles: patch scales as k_f^(-1/2), so the continuum and connectivity ceilings meet at 0.48x C-0001's secant; softer than that, connectivity fails first

thresholds.criterion: crossovers in an anchor patch (no convention)

thresholds.againstConnectivityCeiling: the continuum fails FIRST, at 42 - 8.5 = 33.5 crossovers before severance

thresholds.criterion: crossovers in an anchor patch (no convention)
thresholds.againstConnectivityCeiling: the continuum fails FIRST, at 42 - 41.8 = 0.2 crossovers before severance
unreachable: the criterion fails on the INTACT sheet

findings: The predicate, answered in closed form: at C-0054's connectivity ceiling an anchor's influence patch contains 0.694 crossovers, against C-0009's 3.9 on the intact sheet. Inverted rather than evaluated, the patch reaches exactly one at 18.7 retained, i.e. 37.3 SPENT — so the sheet stops being a continuum FIVE crossovers before it stops being connected, and the plate reduction fails INSIDE the region C-0054 declares buildable.

The three criteria disagree, and which one a design trusts decides the answer. ell_perp/d reads 1.061 at the ceiling — still above one, so the across-helix matched criterion never sees the failure at all; it crosses one only at 44.9 spent, past the ceiling. ell_par/p_eff reads 0.208, and it demands 67.2 crossovers, MORE than the sheet owns, so it fails on the intact sheet and cannot distinguish the ceiling from anything. Only the patch count, which carries no direction convention, crosses inside the design region.

Depleting the crossovers to a quarter is EXACTLY a fourfold stiffer foundation for ell_perp/d — both divide D_perp/k_f by four — and it is not for the other two, which separate by exactly 2 sqrt 2. That is why the ceiling's 1.061 is the same number as C-0009's own 4x-foundation corner, and it is a warning: an across-helix criterion cannot tell a depleted sheet from a stiffer layer.

The continuum density and the integer census stop being the same statement below one crossover per patch. At the ceiling the density says 0.694, and over C-0015's 45 attachment stations 28 of them (30 on C-0054's own round robin, whose column tie-break clusters every survivor into the two lowest columns) have NO retained crossover inside their own influence patch. The load path from those anchors reaches the foundation and never reaches the sheet's across-helix path at all — and WHICH crossovers survive is now a design variable: the mean distance from an anchor to the nearest surviving crossover is 8.37 nm staggered against 14.08 nm on the round robin, 1.68x, at identical count and identical density.

C-0009's own split survives the ceiling and is what settles 'is it still a plate': the answer depends on how the load meets the sheet. Under C-0022's SMOOTH solved load on the 3 x 15 grid the smeared plate is still within 14.9 % of the lattice at the ceiling and is the nearer model; under a CONCENTRATED 100 pN lever it is out by 33.1 % on the staggered retention and 79.4 % on C-0054's round robin — 2 to 5 times worse, and the SPREAD depends on where the load lands relative to the survivors, which is itself the finding. The point compliance a coupling actually feels varies by 2.53x over one crossover cell where the plate says 1.14x: a plate cannot be inhomogeneous, so that spread is not an error in the plate's number, it is a quantity the plate does not have.

What replaces the plate, and the four thresholds fall in a strict order that no single criterion would have produced. The uncoupled BEAM ARRAY — fifteen Euler-Bernoulli duplexes on one shared Winkler foundation — becomes the nearer model to the lattice at 28 spent on the POINT COMPLIANCE, at 18.7 retained on the patch criterion, and only at 45 spent on the SMOOTH dishing, which is severance. So: 28 (a coupling's own stiffness) < 37 (the continuum criterion) < 42 (connectivity) < 45 (a smooth load notices). A design that reads any one of these as 'where the plate fails' is off by up to 1.61x in the crossover count. The concentrated lever crosses at 37 spent on C-0054's round robin and 45 on the staggered retention, which brackets the middle of that order and is the one number here that a PLACEMENT moves.

C-0054's harmonic/smeared discrepancy is NOT a modelling artefact and it is also not what fails first. At and below the ceiling every interface still holds a crossover, the two conventions agree to (15/14)^2 = 1.1480 exactly, and the series reading is finite. The collapse to zero is a property of the FIRST EMPTY interface, which is at 43 spent — one past the ceiling and six past where the patch criterion has already refused the plate.
